  • 【Versatile Style for Multiple Occasions】Perfect for a wide range of activities, from golfing and working to traveling and lounging at home, these versatile flece lined pants offer the perfect blend of style and functionality, keeping you warm and comfortable throughout the autumn and winter seasons.

About knee length skorts

Whether you're hitting the golf course, playing tennis, or enjoying outdoor activities, these skorts deliver unmatched comfort and functionality. The high-rise waistband and strategic pocket placement make these skorts both practical and flattering for every body type.

Skirt Length: 21.1" Liner Inseam: 7.3" (size L)

Fabric:

  • Laureate Collection
  • 90% Polyester,10% Spandex
  • Moisture-wicking, breathable & quick-drying
  • UPF 50+ sun protection

    Features:

    • High-rise style, knee-length
    • This style runs small,we recommend sizing up one size.
    • A wide waistband offers maximum coverage
    • The inner drawstring makes sure it stays put
    • The built-in liner provides more coverage and won't ride up
    • 3 pockets: 1 hidden waistband pocket & 2 side pockets
    • Split hem ensures a free range of motion 
    • Flatlock seams offer no chafing

    Occasion:

    • Perfect for various scenes, such as golf, tennis, running, beach, boating, casual, etc.
